name: startupOS
tagline: A workspace where small businesses post work and World-verified people apply, complete tasks and chat.

awards: World U: Build for the future of the internet with World

problem: Small businesses need reliable, low-cost labour without heavy overhead.
solution: Organisations create jobs, campaigns and projects by form or agent; verified users in a World mini app browse, auto-apply through a browser agent and complete tasks.
demo_moment: Team-described: an organisation posts a job and a verified user applies from the mini app.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “World U: Build for the future of the internet with World” among 307 submissions.
Built by one person across both sides of the marketplace.

lessons: Proof of personhood is strongest where fake accounts break a marketplace.
